title: A Koi Pond Mosaic Made from 10 Pounds of 3D Printer Waste
summary: A creative DIY tutorial on Instructables that transforms approximately 10 pounds of discarded 3D printer waste (primarily PLA filament scraps and failed prints) into a decorative koi pond mosaic for garden or home decoration.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing problem of 3D printer plastic waste by repurposing it into aesthetically pleasing mosaic artwork.
why_valuable: It demonstrates practical environmental consciousness by turning industrial plastic waste into functional art, promoting sustainable making practices.
